subject: design/plan-new-routed-demand
statement: Plangate fold parses plan/v2 closed, resolves every citation, invokes the sole evaluator under the pinned policy, materializes the generated profile/capsule, and rejects any missing/unknown value, native identifier, absent evidence, downward assurance change, or hand-edited generated mismatch before checkpoint presentation. The operator then applies the FR-30 rubric task by task: every axis and raise must be substantively supported by one or more cited anchors; irrelevant, contradictory, or partial support returns the whole plan to the edit loop.
